Kd.bar_b_note: Murky low-value forest with no storm sky or lightning, flat magenta ground telegraphs, a near-invisible player creature and debug HUD panels sink it (A also loses i13/i15 to canopy).

Po.bar_b_note: Warm Meadows grass and a readable badger silhouette help, but rigid creatures under hit bursts and flat lavender telegraphs with no sky or depth fall short of Palworld combat finish.

Lb.bar_b_note: Badger lunges/rears add some life, but the hedgehog holds its idle pose when hit (a STAGGER label with no stagger) and the framing has no horizon or atmospheric light.

Oz.bar_b_note: A top-down camera on a flat grass carpet with static creatures reads as a prototype; B's rear in f23 and the fence landmark later help only slightly.

Px.bar_b_note: The large enemy is off-screen for f01-f13, leaving a cone over a small hedgehog on dark grass, so the fight does not read.

Sb.bar_b_note: An appealing, readable elderly villager with expressive eyes and a natural green-brown palette would sit comfortably beside Palworld characters.

Qi.bar_b_note: B's ember-cracked plates give identity that A's near-black mass lacks, but the hit react is the same as standing, faint mid looks lifted off the floor and faint end crushes to black on both.

Tm.bar_b_note: The blue-grey translucent panel fits the direction, but small pale hints with no teal or controller emphasis (and B's tiny clipped text) miss shipping polish.

top_changes.change: Add a hit/move reaction animation layer (flinch, recoil, stagger, lean) to every creature so hurt and moving frames leave the idle silhouette

Combat camera that keeps both fighters framed and clear of canopy, hides the debug HUD, and replaces flat magenta/lavender ground shapes with telegraphs and impacts made of real objects (stone, dust, lightning)
Lighting and value pass: Stormwood purple storm sky and lightning, creature rim light, lift dark creature materials and faint poses out of near-black, and give Meadows high cameras horizon depth
